policy.identity: Exact original 2024–25 CCD LEA 1201590 / FL-53 and FDOE district 53 school codes. Remove only the documented FL- prefix from CCD FL-53-#### to native 53-####; preserve authoritative 12-digit NCES IDs separately. Official integer or digit school codes are padded to their documented width. Names, corrected digits and guessed crosswalks never establish ownership.
policy.population: Prospective pure lower profiles require exact operational CCD ownership; complete unadjusted reported PK–8 offered flags with a grade3–8 offer and no9–13/UG/AE; native Fall Survey2 explicit zero in every grade9–12 and at least one positive or protected-positive enrolled grade3–8. Offered and enrolled grades remain separate. Primary, zero-tested, high, mixed and uncertain configurations stay outside. Planning, income extremes, school type, charter status and diagnostic quality never select scope. Original above-grade testing scope does not establish participation in a profile with only zero enrolled tested grades.
policy.income: Florida 2024–25 Final Survey 3 (February) raw individual Lunch Status counts: D/F free eligibility + 3/E reduced eligibility + C/R CEP direct certification, divided by same-survey enrolled students (PK–12). Never uses the USDA 1.6-adjusted federal funding numerator or published school-grade economic percentage. CEP N means not individually identified eligible and is excluded from the numerator. Provision 2 code 4 reports all enrolled students, so schools with nonzero or masked code 4 have unavailable income. At CEP schools this proxy counts direct certification/household extension rather than a complete income survey of all families; undercount and reporting coverage are unknown. No other-year backfill.
policy.income_codes: The2024–25 Lunch Status146025 primary definition requires district option6/9 conversions toC/D before reporting. Use each school’s own February Final Survey3 PK–12 denominator and original D/F+3/E+C/R individual counts only when Provision2 code4 is explicit zero. Preserve funding columns9–11 as separate raw evidence, never a model income measure. No USDA1.6 multiplier, School Grades economic percentage, other-year income or enrollment substitution; CEP individual identification coverage remains unknown.
policy.assessment: 2024–25 native School Grades English Language Arts Achievement and Mathematics Achievement components: Level 3 or above / valid assessed students under Florida full-year-enrollment and home-zoned attribution rules, including eligible FAA Performance Task but excluding FAA Datafolio. ELA FAST PM3 grades 3–10 and Math FAST PM3 grades 3–8 plus B.E.S.T./Access Algebra 1/Geometry EOCs; this cohort enrolls no grades 9–12 in the same-year Survey 2 registry. ELL included after two US-school years; medical/extraordinary exemptions excluded. Components require at least 10 eligible students. Native whole-percent rates only; score denominators absent, so all model sampling intervals unavailable. Collocated combined results and provider-specific virtual rates are excluded from individual-school matches.
policy.native_population: Original School Grades2025 Math Achievement column9 and ELA Achievement column6 are published whole Level3-or-above accountable rates. Keep exact native valid accountable population and full-year, home-zoned, ELL-after-two-US-school-years, medical-exemption and eligible FAA performance rules. Preserve prescribed FAST PM3/BEST/Access EOC and above-grade scope; Datafolio and participation remain separate. No grade/component averaging, count-ratio substitution or inferred test administration membership.
policy.suppression: Protected native Fall counts remain unavailable numeric counts with protected-positive presence, never zero or reconstructed. Missing/masked income or achievement remains unavailable. Explicit zero remains zero. Never complement masks or backfill another year.
policy.counts: Published School Grades achievement provides no verified valid-score denominators. The primary guide at-least-ten-eligible component condition does not certify ten valid-scored pupils. All valid-score counts, variances and intervals remain null/unavailable and the scored floor remains uncertified. Enrollment, percent tested, participation, federal95%-adjustment and studentization never substitute. The existing count hold is retained without new speculative investigations.
policy.combined: Equal mean of usable original published Math and ELA rates with own same-year individual income; not the percentage proficient in both.
policy.income_enrollment_discrepancy: Own February Final Survey3 PK–12 denominator is distinct from Fall Survey2, CCD membership and full-year accountable performance. Retain every original school/district total and any exact mismatch without assigning a cause or inventing an identity. None supplies an assessment valid-score denominator.
policy.eligibility: Reconstruct exact original CCD and native district 53 identities, operational status and complete pure lower offered flags. Require native Fall grades 9–12 to be explicit zero and at least one grade 3–8 positive or protected-positive. Compute own February D/F + 3/E + C/R count ratio only with explicit-zero Provision 2 code 4. Select exact campus published Math/ELA fields without provider-specific or collocated attribution. Retain all 110 prospective profiles; Compass Middle Charter School 53-0932 has no campus assessment and remains outside all three 109-member fits. Its missing outcome is never zero. Charters, income extremes and influence never select membership.
policy.models: Separate unweighted centered 2024–25 Polk grade-school Math, ELA and Combined OLS. Combined independently fits the paired 109 original-rate means with its own residual scale, deletions and external studentization. Equal subject cohorts may yield linear coefficient averages but never justify averaging studentized scores. No weights, enrollment adjustment, fit-driven exclusions or national pooling.
policy.studentization: Externally studentized residuals use every explicit deleted-school fit and N−3 residual degrees of freedom, independent centered full fits and held-out leverage. Cook distance and prediction sensitivity over the observed income range are descriptive, never exclusions or clamping.
policy.intervals: All valid-score counts, sampling variances and interval endpoints are null modelwide; the ten-valid-scored floor is uncertified. An internal zero variance vector is solely a point-estimate computational sentinel, never an uncertainty estimate.
policy.compact_provenance: Complete committed immutable source retains all 2,026 original records / 48,356 typed cells, complete headers, notes, primary definitions and outside identities. Exact whole blob, source code/tests/policy/raw/schema/definition/identity fingerprints and current semantic replay are required on every numerical replay, including cached expected fits. Exact inputs and table/workbook/worksheet/row/column references replace repeated raw tables/PDFs.
policy.release: Numerical audit only pending independent review and separate canonical/browser integration. Historical source and numerical source/modeling approvals remain false; high/mixed/primary/missing/closed/unmatched scopes and count holds remain unreleased.

retained_source_reference.note: Complete original records, headers, notes, definitions, membership and outside identities stay in the immutable linked source artifact; every numerical replay requires current available unchanged source/code/tests/policy and semantic validation.

raw_fields: At least ten eligible component rule
count_definition_status.reason: Native enrollment, percent tested and eligible component rules are source evidence; no exact valid-score denominator or ten-valid-scored floor is certified. Income and enrollment never substitute or select model membership.

Individual February lunch status covers all school grades and a different date/population from accountable School Grades achievement. Published whole percentages, full-year and home-zoned attribution, FAST/BEST/Access EOC/FAA scope, ELL and exemption rules remain limits; Datafolio only contributes to percent tested. No valid-score denominator or ten-valid-scored floor is certified.

intervals.reason: School Grades contains no verified valid-score denominators. Its at-least-ten-eligible component rule does not certify ten valid-scored students; original published achievement supports point-only numerical audit without counts or intervals.

diagnostics.interpretation: Descriptive influence flags only; no school is excluded by leverage, residual or fit quality. Native whole-percent precision, broader February individual income, full-year accountable FAST/BEST/Access/FAA achievement and uncertified valid-score/floor definitions remain limitations; predictions are never clamped.

independent_verification.method: Centered full OLS; centered closed-form leverage; every explicit leave-one-out fit uses N−3 scale and held-out variance factor 1+h_deleted. Interval verification is inapplicable because all verified valid-score denominators are unavailable; Native own February denominator, Fall/CCD membership, percent tested and component-eligibility rules remain linked original provenance, never certified assessment denominators or a scored-count-floor certificate.
